3530-love-at-arms.title: Love At Arms
3530-love-at-arms.creator: Raphael Sabatini
3530-love-at-arms.description: A book by Raphael Sabatini. “Your Excellency will be tired,” cried Fabrizio, with that ready solicitude which is ever at the orders of the great. “A cup of Puglia wine, my lord. Here, Fanfulla,” he called, to the young nobleman who had acted as usher. But the new-comer silenced him and put the matter aside with a gesture.

All dull and uninteresting numbers and tedious unnecessary repetitions have been left out, while the valuable music of the opera has been retained and the same has been brought together into a harmonious whole.

arxiv-2103-16517.title: Jannis Lang, Stefan Liebler, Heiko Schäfer-Siebert, Dieter Zeppenfeld
arxiv-2103-16517.description: Abstract Effective field theories (EFT) are commonly used to parameterize effects of BSM physics in vector boson scattering (VBS). For Wilson coefficients which are large enough to produce presently observable effects, the validity range of the EFT represents only a fraction of the energy range covered by the LHC, however.

arxiv-2206-04156.title: Feedback cooled Bose-Einstein condensation: near and far from equilibrium
arxiv-2206-04156.creator: Evan P. Yamaguchi, Hilary M. Hurst, I. B. Spielman
arxiv-2206-04156.description: Abstract Continuously measured interacting quantum systems almost invariably heat, causing loss of quantum coherence. Here, we study Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) subject to repeated weak measurement of the atomic density and describe several protocols for generating a feedback signal designed to remove excitations created by measurement backaction.

arxiv-2306-15289.title: Numerical Investigation of Water Entry of Hydrophobic Spheres.
arxiv-2306-15289.creator: Jaspreet Singh, Anikesh Pal
arxiv-2306-15289.description: Abstract We perform numerical simulations to study the dynamics of the entry of hydrophobic spheres in a pool of water using ANSYS. To track the air-water interface during the translation of the sphere in the pool of water, we use the volume of fluid (VOF) model. The continuum surface force (CSF) method computes the surface tension force.

arxiv-2312-11574.title: Searching for the first radial excitation of the Δ ⁡ ( 1232 ) \Delta(1232) in lattice QCD
arxiv-2312-11574.creator: Liam Hockley, Waseem Kamleh, Derek Leinweber, Anthony Thomas
arxiv-2312-11574.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Liam Hockley, Waseem Kamleh, Derek Leinweber, Anthony Thomas. We present a lattice QCD analysis of the Δ \Delta -baryon spectrum, with the goal of finding the position of the 2 ​ s 2s radial excitation of the Δ ⁡ ( 1232 ) \Delta(1232) ground state.

arxiv-2404-14041.title: Natural Capital as a Stock Option
arxiv-2404-14041.creator: O. Bertolami
arxiv-2404-14041.description: Abstract The unfolding climate crisis is a physical manifestation of the damage that market economy, driven by the high intensity consumption of fossil fuels, has inflicted on the Earth System and on the stability conditions that were established by a complex conjugation of natural factors during the Holoecene.

arxiv-2507-00910.title: Existence and stability of Sadovskii vortices: from vortex patches to regular vorticity
arxiv-2507-00910.creator: Kyudong Choi, Young-Jin Sim, Kwan Woo
arxiv-2507-00910.description: Abstract . We consider traveling wave solutions of the incompressible Euler equations in ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} , taking the form of a counter-rotating dipole that touches the symmetry axis. We refer to such solutions as Sadovskii vortices, in honor of Sadovskii’s contribution ( J. Appl. Math. Mech. , 1971).

arxiv-2508-16998.title: DeAR: Dual-Stage Document Reranking with Reasoning Agents via LLM Distillation
arxiv-2508-16998.creator: Abdelrahman Abdallah, Jamshid Mozafari, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt
arxiv-2508-16998.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed listwise document reranking by enabling global reasoning over candidate sets, yet single models often struggle to balance fine-grained relevance scoring with holistic cross-document analysis. We propose De ep A gent R ank ( DeAR ), an open-source framework that decouples these tasks through a dual-stage approach, achieving superior accuracy and interpretability.

arxiv-2511-01372.title: AudioNet: Supervised Deep Hashing for Retrieval of Similar Audio Events
arxiv-2511-01372.creator: Sagar Dutta, Vipul Arora
arxiv-2511-01372.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sagar Dutta, Vipul Arora. This work presents a supervised deep hashing method for retrieving similar audio events. The proposed method, named AudioNet, is a deep-learning-based system for efficient hashing and retrieval of similar audio events using an audio example as a query. AudioNet achieves high retrieval performance on multiple standard datasets by generating binary hash codes for similar audio events, setting new benchmarks in the field, and highlighting its efficacy and effectiveness compare to other hashing methods.

pmc-10512509.title: Intramedullary Kirschner wire fixation of displaced distal forearm fractures in children
pmc-10512509.creator: Mohamed I Abulsoud, Ahmed Saied Mohammed, Mohammed Elmarghany, Ahmed Elgeushy, Ehab Elzahed, Mohamed Moawad, Ehab A Elshal, Mohamed F Elhalawany, Yahia A Hassanein, Amr A Fouad, Ahmed R Zakaria
pmc-10512509.description: Aim of the workThis study was designed to highlight internal fixation by intramedullary K-wires for displaced distal forearm fractures among children and analyze the results of this technique. We hypothesize that physis-sparing intramedullary fixation prevents displacement with a lower complication rate.MethodsThis prospective case series involving 47 patients was conducted between February 2018 and December 2019.

pmc-11382154.title: In Situ-Generated Formamidine as a Carbon/Nitrogen Source for Enaminone Formation: One-Pot Synthesis of Functionalized 4-Acyl-1,2,3-triazoles
pmc-11382154.creator: Jia-Xin Lin, You-Xin Chen, Min-Cheng Chien, Hsiang-Jou Chen, Chian-Hui Lai, Chien-Fu Liang
pmc-11382154.description: N,N-Dimethylformamide was reacted with hexamethyldisilazane to generate an N,N-dimethylformimidamide intermediate; thereafter, a reaction with acetophenones/β-diketones was induced to form enaminones. The one-pot synthetic protocol described in this paper can be applied to synthesize 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazoles and 1,4,5-trisubstituted 1,2,3-triazoles, in which organic azides are used as substrates under optimized conditions.

pmc-12731388.title: Microstructural White Matter Alterations in Pediatric Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension: A Diffusion Tensor Imaging Study
pmc-12731388.creator: Bilge Özgör, Hüseyin Ayvaz, Mahir Tan, Sevgi Demiröz Taşolar, Gül Yücel, Işınsu Bıçakcıoğlu, Serdal Güngör, Ilias Tsiflikas, Ming Lim
pmc-12731388.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Fractional anisotropy values in the optic radiation and posterior limb of the internal capsule were significantly reduced in pediatric idiopathic intracranial hypertension, indicating microstructural white matter alterations detectable by diffusion tensor imaging.DTI metrics—particularly FA—demonstrated strong discriminative accuracy (AUC = 0.83) for distinguishing affected patients from healthy controls, outperforming conventional MRI markers.

pmc-13091126.title: Mild thermal unfolding of pea protein enhances curcumin binding and interfacial properties of the resulting complexes
pmc-13091126.creator: Lijuan Luo, Ping Li, Hui Yang, Mingwei Zhang
pmc-13091126.description: This study investigated how thermal treatment (80–100 °C) alters the structure of pea protein isolate (PPI) and affects curcumin encapsulation and the interfacial properties of PPI-curcumin complexes. Heating induced progressive tertiary loosening, as shown by fluorescence red shifts, increased surface hydrophobicity, and more negative zeta potential.
